decisions.decision_note: E002 and E004 partially clarify location, fit, and rod guidance but leave the retention and movement arrangement unsettled; E003 only resumes the requirement. E006 provides the first complete selected arrangement: rod-nut retention at the sliding end, with the bushing sliding inside the main shaft on its outside diameter.

E006 directly selects rod-nut retention in the sliding end and specifies that the bushing slides inside the main shaft, settling rigid retention versus free movement and replacing screw retention with the stated rod-nut arrangement.
